title: Console accessibility: unnamed icon buttons, a notification bell named only by its count, and no nav landmark on the sidebar
body:
qa#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AecbS6JEeLdRWSW4AC

Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced on a public entry (reach below).

QA-source: #32135 · browser walk (runner C), accessibility · observed beside the clauses
Batch-of: objectstack-ai/objectstack#32135 follow-ups, 15 cards filed on the maintainer's 「立卡处理」

## What we saw

Reach: the console shell on every page (framework ff04ad81), checked with role-based queries:
- Eight icon buttons on the task list page (nav-group collapse toggles) have no accessible name; the mobile sidebar toggle has none either.
- The notification bell's accessible name is just the count ("3").
- The sidebar is not a `<nav>` landmark (`nav` count 0).
Good already: skip link, `html lang` follows locale, one `h1`, no unlabeled inputs, visible focus.

## Proposed change

Give every icon-only button an `aria-label`; name the bell "Notifications, 3 unread"; wrap the sidebar in `<nav aria-label=…>`.

## Business reason

Who: screen-reader and keyboard users, and any customer with an accessibility requirement in procurement. Cost: the shell cannot be navigated by landmark and its controls are announced as "button".

## Reader

Triage first touch; lands in `ui/` (app-shell).

## Duplicate check

`is:issue repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack accessible name icon button nav landmark` (3 hits, none relevant): no card.
